name: Kilo Gateway
summary: Personal Kilo Gateway account with one explicit free-model Chat route. Exhausted credit remains a reported account state; no top-up or paid fallback is required.

credentials.label: Personal Kilo Gateway API key
credentials.help: Personal account > Your Profile > bottom of page > API key. Use the personal account key, not an organization token or an upstream BYOK key; enter privately in lain.

setupSteps.title: Find your existing personal key
setupSteps.description: Open Your Profile on the personal account and copy the Gateway API key privately into lain. The documented key lives at the bottom of that page.

setupSteps.title: Confirm the explicit free model
setupSteps.description: Check that google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it:free is still offered and review its data handling. Availability changes; do not substitute a paid or auto route.

setupSteps.title: Keep the exhausted account unchanged
setupSteps.description: No purchase, credit top-up, auto top-up, BYOK or paid fallback is part of this setup. A rejected request leaves the live check open; it does not authorize another billing route.
